title: AI Coding 2026: Cursor vs. Copilot vs. Claude Code 🤖
summary: Short Copilot vs Cursor vs Claude Code comparison; generic and partly outdated model references.

assertions.quote: It's great for the file you're in, but it can struggle with massive cross-repo refactors

verdicts.note: Copilot's broad IDE support is true, but by 2026 it has agent mode and multi-file edits; 'smaller context' framing is dated.

assertions.quote: it indexes your entire codebase locally

verdicts.note: Cursor's indexing and model choice are accurate; 'most integrated' is a taste judgment and competitors have closed gaps.

assertions.quote: Use Claude Code when you have a nightmare bug or a massive refactor

verdicts.note: Claude Code is widely regarded as strong on autonomous multi-step tasks, but 'best' varies by task and model release; Codex and others compete.

assertions.quote: many pros are actually using a hybrid stack

verdicts.note: Developer surveys (e.g. Stack Overflow 2025) show many use multiple AI tools concurrently.
